column2: Action Item Description
Check for any account or campaign anomalies
Check monthly budget trend - are we on track to spend their budget?
Check weekly performance compared to historical averages and make sure performance is on track and there are no anomalies in the last week.
Look for budget limited campaigns - is the budget being allocated across campaigns to maximize performance at monthly budget cap?
Review search query reports and add new keywords with sufficient volume
Review search query reports and add new negative keywords
Review campaign bid strategies and adjust if needed.
Check feed for any errors. Check feed for disapprovals.
Check for any major movements in IS%
Look for new competitors or any changes in competitors.
Review any on-going tests and make any necessary adjustments
Develop new ad tests and evaluate the performance of existing ones.
Check and dismiss any Google recommendations to improve Optimization Score (this prevents Google reps contacting clients as well)
Check Quality Score fluctuations
Check Monthly performance compared to previous month and previous year
Review campaign structures - does it make sense to split any or combine any?
Identify top sellers in PMax or Shopping campaigns
Identify poor performers in PMax or Shopping campaigns - should poor performers be excluded from PMax and tested in Standard Shopping?
Review DSA campaigns
Review DSA auto targets
Review GA4 Account
Conduct keyword research to fill any missing gaps
Analyze the performance of PMax products and review insights tab.
Review landing page performance and load times
Review scripts and auto rules. Do they still make sense? Are they functioning properlly?
Evaluate what worked and what didn't
Develop a plan for the next 3 month sprint
Analyze device performance
Assess search partner effectiveness
Evaluate ad scheduling
Analyze geographic targeting
Evaluate audience targeting & update audience lists
Check if all ad assets are applied and still relevant
Compare account vs website and identify potential categories or products for expansion
Review competiors and conduct comeptitor gap analysis
Determine what has not been tested in the last 90 days
Review the Shopping feed for any optimization opportunities
Review and update any remarketing lists including Customer Match lists
